headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers, securing a 7-6 victory. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In another close game, the Pirates edged the Brewers 3-2, with Yohan Ramírez earning the win and Mason Montgomery notching the save.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Atlanta Braves due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins have transferred Anthony Banda to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain, while Nick Kurtz is out for the Athletics with a right thumb capsule sprain.

The Chicago White Sox made a midseason trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Edge Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Yohan Ramírez earning the win and Mason Montgomery notching the save.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, unable to overcome a strong Twins performance. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have placed left fielder Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. This move comes on July 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. This move comes as the White Sox look to bolster their roster ahead of the second half of the season.
